'''Vran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Saber]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], and a crewmember of the ''[[Starstalker]]'' alongside his sister, [[Kaara]]. They took place in the endeavor to acquire [[wintrium]] from the [[Fountain of Ancients]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], and they were met by resistance from [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards. Kaara was killed in the [[Violation|skirmish]], and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were attacked by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who were sworn to protect the Fountain. Later, the ''Starstalker''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Vyn Holpur]], and the rest of the crew, including Vran, were sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] for violating the Fountain.
